clips.title: The story
paras: Terenthis asks scouts in Auberdine to learn whether furbolg corruption has reached Darkshore. After madness takes hold among furbolgs in Teldrassil, the night elf druid sends them to inspect mainland settlements across the sea.

Night elves across northern Kalimdor have long lived peacefully with the furbolg tribes. Since the Third War, strange corruption has unhinged furbolg minds in Teldrassil. They have kidnapped and attacked their former allies. Terenthis, a druid stationed in Auberdine, fears the affliction has spread beyond the World Tree to the mainland tribes along Darkshore’s coast.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Some of my brethren were rescued from a corrupt furbolg in Teldrassil, and I've vowed to stop any more atrocities before more of our kind are injured... Or worse.

I have seen a couple hints of corruption in Darkshore already, but I have yet to find any widespread signs. I think it would be logical if the investigation continued with the furbolgs. Would you find one of their camps, and return to me if you see any signs of corruption?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is terrible news indeed, friend.
With the furbolgs this close to Auberdine, we will have to prepare ourselves for the inevitable.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
